### E1-6 – Gross Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3 and total GHG emissions

In 2021, Banco BPM measured greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions associated with its own operations and other indirect activities. Scope 2 emissions were reported for the consolidated accounting group under the financial-control approach; the figures for own operations and the consolidated accounting group were identical.
